research_objective: Learn from literature in the field to propose three candidate research gaps/frontier directions, formulate research questions/hypotheses from them, and use evidence-grounded LLM analysis to test whether the pilot corpus supports, contradicts, or leaves them unresolved.

candidate_gap_directions_preserved.summary: More detailed in-plant cooling-water process representation jointly considered with power-system operation.
Fast cyber/information-layer sensing and its use with slower water/thermal/hydraulic dynamics for early warning or closed-loop control.
Extending physical-network service-loss analysis toward critical-facility, population, and social-vulnerability outcomes.
